text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, there's a new update for 'The 
Splendid Saint Does Not Hesitate' on the 
site♪ Let me see here...――

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"The Saint's battle has only just begun! 
The End! Thank you for reading"... Huh, 
what?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? Huh? Um... What about the 
long-lost younger sister? And what ended 
up happening with the alliance with the 
Eastern Nations—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
“...... No, this is the ending the author 
envisioned. Please, spin another tale for 
us once more.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And while wishing the author happiness, 
she couldn't help but feel a pang of 
loneliness.
